errors.evidence: The plot shows the starting learning rate at Epoch 1 is exactly on the 0.0002 grid line, not 0.000211.
The plot shows the peak learning rate at Epoch 5 is exactly on the 0.0010 grid line, not 0.000994.

The linear decay of the learning rate from Epoch 5 (0.001) to Epoch 30 results in a value of exactly 0 at Epoch 30, which is visually confirmed by the plot. The reported value of 0.000016 is incorrect.
The description fails to mention that there are two distinct types of blue markers: circles for the warm-up phase (Epochs 1-4) and stars for the decay phase (Epochs 5-30).
